data.gender_notes: Aasim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aasim is a name that signifies hastening or racing towards good deeds. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with the concept of hastening towards Allah's mercy. The name Aasim carries the meaning “One who hastens” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aasim usually hope their child will grow to embody one who hastens and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: He who hastens towards Allah's mercy and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Aasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who hastens.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aasim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aasim holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it is a name given to children to encourage them to strive for excellence and good deeds. It is also a name associated with the Prophet Aasim bin Abi Al-Aas (ra), who was known for his bravery and dedication to Islam during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aasim is imbued with spiritual significance as it represents the idea of hastening towards Allah's mercy and guidance. It is a reminder to constantly focus on doing good deeds and seeking Allah's pleasure, as time is precious and fleeting. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Save yourself from the Hellfire even by giving a morsel of food in the name of Allah" (Bukhari), emphasizing the importance of good actions and striving towards Allah's mercy. Therefore, the name Aasim reflects the values of obedience and dedication to Allah and the desire to continually improve one's character and actions.
